1.summary: Add src/brain/state.rs: full serde model for state.json (StateFile, Focus, Block, BlockedBy internally-tagged enum, Track, RepoRollup, CrossRepoEdge, TierEntry) plus load_state() loader; registered in mod.rs; 14 unit tests cover all five live file shapes and error paths.
decisions: BlockedBy uses #[serde(tag = type, rename_all = snake_case)] — unknown type values fail deserialization by default (no #[serde(other)]), which is the desired E_STATE_SCHEMA_BAD_BLOCKED_BY behavior
StateFile tolerates extra fields (no deny_unknown_fields) and uses #[serde(default)] on all optional collections — matches the lenient superset design in the spec
TierEntry and top-level note field added to match the live HQ state.json which contains both
Tests use inline JSON strings (same pattern as sync.rs) rather than fixture files — simpler and self-contained for a model-only task
